The exact signed predicate requires a public path to a listening port and the historical handler requires ListeningPortVerified plus complete listener/target/route/ingress inventories. The available independently validated native model proves only a bounded direct IPv4 configuration allowance, with application_listening=unknown and all_paths_evaluated=false. Neither that positive witness nor its absence settles the old listener contract. PublicReachability assertions in legacy fixtures have no authoritative listener producer. Quarantine this exact historical contract while preserving lineage and keeping the active native configuration alternatives available. This is an unsupported evidence/semantics classification, not an owner-input requirement or a blanket claim that future AWS-native ELB/telemetry proofs are impossible.
